english.title: Improperly construct a water-closet / drain / soil pipe so as to prejudice health
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to section 63(1) of the Building Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) It is a defence to show that the prejudice to health could not have been avoided by the exercise of reasonable care
(ii) In this section in its application to Greater London, a reference to a water-closet includes a reference to a urinal
